description: Called from Holywell, set the two men at sixpence and the chain after the play, and yielded on the flag.
name: Cuthbert Burbage

description: Walked the playhouse with a lantern. He was not on the call. His son reported him.
name: James Burbage

description: Not on the call. You said the flag had been his opinion first.
name: John Heminges

description: Played in Fair Em and set the strip down after.
name: William Shakespeare
